title: Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Pre-July-2024 matters)

sections.heading: Special powers of High Court or Court of Session regarding bail
sections.text: (1) A High Court or Court of Session may direct that any person accused of an offence and in custody be released on bail, and if the arrest is of the nature specified in sub-section (3) of section 437, may impose any condition which it considers necessary for the purposes mentioned in that sub-section. (2) A High Court or Court of Session may direct that any person who has been released on bail under this Chapter be arrested and commit him to custody.
